Q5028.reason: A recorded plat that sets aside a tract for a public school is best treated as a dedication of an easement for public use, not a covenant among the lot owners.

Q5787.reason: Firing a gun at a person in a crowd is extreme recklessness (depraved heart), which is more than mere negligence, so the resulting death can be murder.

Q5115.reason: Lactate is made from pyruvate, so it can't rise when pyruvate formation is blocked. Activating glycolysis at the start of exercise raises pyruvate and lactate production.
